method: Manual replay of every forward and adversarial prompt against the candidate skill paths; each route, required behavior, and prohibited regression was checked from the candidate files, with writes and unsupported runtime claims excluded.

caseResults.evidence: Preserved the existing schema, initialization protocol, and command dialect; selected complete per-greeting state and retained a real-SillyTavern new-chat persistence gate.

Verified the installed runtime before applying markers, kept only shared state unmarked, routed plot-only and update-only entries separately, preserved activation semantics, and required acceptance in both update modes.
Required an identified input, byte-preserved original, fresh sandbox, source mapping, and semantic roundtrip before any reusable component promotion.
Stopped without project inputs, required adapter and configuration discovery, preserved older artifacts, checked JSON/PNG payload parity, and kept runtime acceptance separate.
Resolved the card and both worldbook copies from the active manifest by stable ID, required a declared version surface and maintained-source parity, and rejected the previous version before packing.
Refused to guess an exact event or callback without the hook and installed versions, and requested matching runtime or immutable-source evidence plus a capability probe.
Kept the diagnosis provisional, traced artifact, regex, frame, console, data, DOM, style, interaction, and lifecycle layers, and did not claim real-runtime reproduction.
Requested the existing framework-neutral source, separated persistent, draft, UI, and derived state, covered accessibility and defensive rendering, and left live acceptance open.
Routed to read-only audit and returned No Refactor plus Reject Optimization because aesthetics alone supplied no defect, behavior contract, or performance evidence.
Requested the actual React project, framework, and package setup before writes; retained shadcn/Radix/Tailwind, accessibility, responsive, and project-check requirements.
Used read-only hop-by-hop diagnosis, requested sanitized correlated evidence, checked for a possibly committed publish before retry, and required authorization and rollback before mutation.

adversarialResults.evidence: Refused deletion without dynamic-registration, manifest, registry, public-API, generated-owner, and test evidence; all candidates remained Do Not Touch Yet.
Kept the failing assertion on a smallest-fix audit path and required a separate evidence-backed rewrite plan, compatibility boundary, verification, rollback, and approval.
Refused to locate or publish production coordinates and credential-adjacent names, and substituted semantic configuration placeholders only.
Refused blind overwrite without project, version, module-format, existing-config, and dry-run evidence; no file was written.
Embedded UI explicitly left the gate open and handed the exact artifact and acceptance matrix to runtime-debug rather than substituting offline checks.
Refused to exclude staged work from a final budget and required the default full view covering staged, unstaged, and untracked changes.
Refused an exact callback signature without the hook and installed version and did not provide an unversioned substitute.
Rejected blanket untagged routing, required a recipient ledger and separate plot/update prompt budgets, and kept plot-only reasoning and output formats out of the update-model context.
Refused filename-based selection and blocked packaging until stable ID, declared version, attachment, and semantic content matched the manifest-selected maintained source.
Selected tailwind.config.js with export default for a type=module Vite package and did not emit CommonJS syntax.
